quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: the procedure for its acquisition of Australia's SDI has been completed and SDI will be consolidated from Q3 2026. Its nano-scale composite zirconia powder for dental use is mainly used to make zirconia blocks for dental fixed restorations; the company will seize the opportunity from China's rare-earth export-control policy to further raise the product's market share.
